input.query:
SELECT 
    s.s_suppkey,
    s.s_name,
    n.n_name AS nation,
    COUNT(*) AS total_line_items,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delayed_shipments,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS delay_rate_pct,
    AVG(l.l_receiptdate - l.l_shipdate) AS avg_delivery_days,
    AVG(l.l_commitdate - l.l_shipdate) AS avg_committed_lead_days
FROM supplier s
JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name
